name: Arcane Mantle (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School evocation; Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range self
Area 30-foot-radius aura
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You radiate arcane force out to 30 feet, granting your allies more arcane force to your allies’ attacks and effects. All damage dealt by your allies within range, by spell, attack or ability, deals an additional 1d3 force damage. If the spell affects multiple creatures, only one target of the spell, of the caster’s choice, is affected.
